facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.create_Config: create a Config instance to set E-LPIPS metric type, dropout, offset, flip, scale, and color randomization options
facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.call_set_scale_levels: call set_scale_levels on a Config to set the number of scale levels and their inverse-square probabilities

facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.call_sample_ensemble: call sample_ensemble with a Config to sample random offset, flip, swap, color, and scale transformation parameters

facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.build_squeezenet_forward: build a SqueezeNet 1.1 network and run forward pass to extract 7 ReLU feature maps

facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.create_PNetLin_vgg: create a PNetLin instance using VGG16 as the pretrained network for perceptual similarity
facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.create_PNetLin_squeeze: create a PNetLin instance using SqueezeNet 1.1 as the pretrained network for perceptual similarity
facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.forward_perceptual_distance: compute perceptual distances between two NHWC image tensors using the PNetLin forward method
facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.normalize_tensor_features: normalize a tensor to unit length along the depth feature dimension using normalize_tensor

facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.build_switch_case_where: build a TensorFlow tensor using switch_case_where to select values from multiple condition-effect pairs

facebookresearch_neural-light-fields/bas.test_f32_to_dtype: test the f32_to_dtype function to cast a TensorFlow tensor from float32 to another dtype
